The optional rhythm score view uses VexFlow 4.2.5, Bravura-only bundle,
unchanged from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vexflow@4.2.5/build/cjs/vexflow-bravura.js.
VexFlow copyright Mohit Muthanna Cheppudira, MIT (VEXFLOW-LICENSE.txt).
Bravura copyright Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH, SIL Open Font License 1.1,
Reserved Font Name Bravura (BRAVURA-LICENSE.txt).
https://github.com/steinbergmedia/bravura

The library is served locally and loaded only when the score view is opened.
Its embedded original Bravura glyph outlines render as SVG paths; a browser
system music font or an external font download is not used.
